macros.name: AppendGraphicsExtensions
macros.doc: macro \AppendGraphicsExtensions adds the entries after the end of graphics’ list, whereas macro \PrependGraphicsExtensions puts them in front of the list.

macros.name: PrintGraphicsExtensions
macros.doc: Macro \PrintGraphicsExtensions writes the current graphics extensions list in the .log file.

macros.name: RemoveGraphicsExtensions
macros.doc: All occurences of file extensions in ⟨ext-list⟩ are removed from graphics’ extension list.
